question: Which of the following is NOT a local name for Western Ghats?'
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cardamom hills in Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sahyadri hills** is a local name for the Western Ghats in Maharashtra.
 
• **Anaimalai hills** is a local name for the Western Ghats in Kerala.
 
• **Nilgiri hills** is a local name for the Western Ghats in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.
 
• **Cardamom hills** is a local name for the Western Ghats, but it is predominantly located in Kerala and not in Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats**:

 
 
• The Western Ghats, also known as Sahyadri, is a mountain range that runs parallel to the western coast of the Indian peninsula.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is one of the eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity in the world.
 
• The range starts near the border of Gujarat and Maharashtra and runs approximately 1,600 km through the states of Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu ending at Kanyakumari.
 
• The Western Ghats influence the Indian monsoon weather pattern and are known for their rich biodiversity, including many endemic species of flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Local Names of Western Ghats**:
 
 
• **Sahyadri**: This is the local name for the Western Ghats in Maharashtra. The term Sahyadri means "the Benevolent Mountains."
 
• **Anaimalai Hills**: Also known as the Elephant Hills, these are a part of the Western Ghats located in Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Nilgiri Hills**: Known as the Blue Mountains, this part of the Western Ghats lies at the junction of the states of Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala.
 
• **Cardamom Hills**: These hills are part of the southern Western Ghats located in Kerala. They are named after the cardamom spice grown in this region.
